It was released by [[Takara Tomy]] in Japan on March 21st, 2025 for 11000円 on the Takara Tomy Mall website.[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/lineup/bx00-25set.html Product listing on Takara Tomy website] The set had a regular retail release from Takara Tomy Asia in other Asian countries. There is no Korean release from [[Youngtoys]], likely due to licensing issues with the [[Original Series]] and [[Metal Series]] trademarks. The set had a regular retail release by [[Hasbro]] in mid-2025, with an exclusive early release at San Diego Comic-Con 2025, on July 24th, 2025.[https://www.thegamer.com/exclusive-hasbro-to-release-beyblade-x-25th-anniversary-set-at-san-diego-comic-con-2025/ ''Hasbro To Release Beyblade X 25th Anniversary Set At San Diego Comic-Con 2025''] Unlike other Hasbro products, it is completely identical to the Takara Tomy release. ==Contents== *[[DragoonStorm 4-60RA]] *[[StormPegasis 3-70RA]] *[[VictoryValkyrie 2-60RA]] *[[DranSword 3-60F]] (Holo Sticker Version) *[[Winder Launcher]] *[[Winder Launcher L]] (with Dragon Winder) *[[String Launcher (Beyblade X)|String Launcher]] (2x) *Stickers ==Gallery== ===Takara T

It was released in western countries on January 1st, 2026 for USD$29.99 in the United States. ==Contents== *[[Mail Knight 3-85BS]] *[[Blade - Hammer Incendio|Hammer Incendio]] (Metal Coat: Blue) *[[Blade - Circle Ghost|Circle Ghost]] *[[Ratchet - 4-55|4-55]] *[[Ratchet - 7-70|7-70]] *[[Ratchet - 9-65|9-65]] *[[Bit - Ball|Ball]] *[[Bit - Metal Needle|Metal Needle]] *[[Bit - Point|Point]] *[[Bit - Rubber Accel|Rubber Accel]] *Instructions ==Gallery== X-treme Expansion Pack Box Backside.jpeg|Back of the box X-treme Expansion Pack Contents.jpeg|Contents KnightMail 3-85BS.jpeg|Mail Knight 3-85BS ==Trivia== *This set is mostly a repackaged version of Takara Tomy's [[Customize Set U]] with some changes: **The [[Blade - TyrannoBeat|TyrannoBeat]] and [[Blade - Talon Ptera|PteraSwing]] Blades are replaced with [[Blade - GhostCircle|Circle Ghost]], keeping this set's Blade selection to just Unique Line Blades. **The [[Ratchet - 1-60|1-60 Ratchet]] is replaced with exclusive recolors of [[Ratchet - 4-55|4-55]] and [[Ratchet - 9-65|9-65]]. **The [[Bit - Rush|Rush Bit]] is the only Bit that is excluded from this set. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Beyblade X Products (Hasbro)}}
